title: VTC Events — Invitations — Respond — payload
description: An invited member answers: going or maybe, which registers them as vtc/events/registrations/register would, or decline, which records that they will not come and registers nothing. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

answers.description: Going or maybe: answers to the event's questions.

codeOfConductAcknowledged.description: Going or maybe: the digest of the code of conduct acknowledged.

Response.title: VTC Events — Invitations — Respond — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/invitations/respond/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/invitations/respond/0.1#response.

registration.description: Going or maybe: the registration, the member's receipt.
